I built a personalized signal play for Ziosk off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ziosk needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
